author: alari
title: Hiring Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist for character illustrations
content:
Hiring!!

Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
Remote 
Design

Required Skills
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe Photoshop

What You’ll Do: Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

Project Snapshot: 10-12 weeks project, Ideally upto 40 hours/week but Part timers upto 20 hrs are also welcomed, Fully remote | Paid in USD, Start as soon as onboarding and portfolio approval are completed.

Contact: If you're interested, reply under this comment and I'll send the link and full details to your DM.
budget: Paid in USD (task-based, up to 40 hrs/week for 10-12 weeks)
